QuestInfo.name: Dawn Warrior Knighthood Exam
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Light #b#p1101003##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101003#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat the monster in it.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. The honor of the Cygnus Knights rests on your shoulders.

default.0: You have not completed the task. Go to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k and prove yourself.

0.0: Are you ready for your Knighthood Exam? Pass it, and you'll be one step further on the glorious path to ultimate knighthood! Are you ready to begin right now?
0.1: The exam is simple. Head to the #bSecond Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters.
0.2: I will bestow knighthood upon you when your task is complete.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to #m130020000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Talk to me when you're ready to start the exam.
